manifest.name: csv-analyst
manifest.description: Loads CSV/TSV files, profiles them, and answers analytical questions with charts.

readme_md:
# CSV Analyst

Your data sidekick. Drop CSVs into the workspace and ask questions in plain English.

## Features

- Column profiling (types, nulls, cardinality)
- Aggregations and group-bys
- Chart rendering (delegated to a visualization sub-agent)

## Delegation

Heavy plotting is delegated to a dedicated visualization sub-agent via Primordial delegation. This keeps the analyst lean and lets the plot renderer evolve independently.

```
primordial run github:datasmith/csv-analyst --workspace ./data
```
